title: NightML's Allay Totem
description: Changes the Totem of Undying into an Allay Totem aesthetic.
body:
# NightML's Allay Totem
## Part of the 15 Totems Collection

The Totem of Undying has many theories and lores behind it within the Minecraft community.

One of the many being that the Illagers capture Allays, and in the process of turning them into Vexs, the Allays' souls turn into Totems.

### Several Minecraft versions
It works for Minecraft versions 26.0 (and likely further). Be aware that in most versions, a warning may appear that it is for the wrong version, but as long as you are using it in 1.21.8 or later - it should work, so no worries.

## Created by NightML, aka NightMareLore. 

Taking suggestions for resourcepacks via email: nightmarelore.10@gmail.com

Please enjoy! But, don't feel inclined to download it, if it isn't your style.
Though there is no active content, music videos will be eventually uploaded to **@NightMareLore10** on YouTube. [Please subscribe for more updates - completely free!]
